historical_record.description: A one-story, four-unit building stood at the property.
The City Planning Commission did not take discretionary review and approved the demolition.
The City Planning Commission took discretionary review and approved the project with the removal of the fourth floor and the corridor door on sheet A2.
The City Planning Commission approved the conditional use authorization for three dwelling units on the lot, with the conditions placed on item 10b.
